meta.title: MaktabatyPro — Offline Moroccan Document Management
hero.paragraph: The offline workspace to build smart templates, automate calculations, and archive your administrative documents locally. Built for Moroccan public writers and administrative professionals.

problem.card1.oldText: Entering the same client data by hand in every form, calculating dates and ages, and writing amounts in words yourself.
problem.card1.newText: Enter the data once and the app handles the calculations and dates automatically.
problem.card2.title: Software & website chaos
problem.card2.oldText: Opening 4 different sites to compress, merge, and edit your PDF files.
problem.card2.newText: A complete toolbox bringing everything you need together in one program on your computer.
problem.card3.title: Constant privacy worry

problem.card3.newText: 100% local work with no internet — nothing ever leaves your computer.

features.capability.smartVariables.title: Auto-updating Dates & Serial Numbers
features.capability.smartVariables.text: Today's date, the current year, and serial numbers — inserted and updated automatically. No manual entry needed.
features.capability.conditionalFields.te: Show or hide sections based on what the user selects. If gender = female, show specific fields. No more irrelevant sections.
features.capability.loopFields.title: Dynamic Client Lists
features.capability.loopFields.text: Easily add rows for multiple family members, clients, or invoice items — add, remove, and reorder as needed.
features.capability.mathExpressions.text: Automatically calculates age from birth dates, converts numbers to words, or sums amounts — live as you type.
features.capability.batchFill.title: Batch Fill
features.capability.batchFill.text: Fill one template with data for 50 people at once. Perfect for public writers processing documents in bulk.
features.capability.livePreview.title: Live Preview
features.capability.livePreview.text: See the final document update in real-time as you fill each field. No surprises after export.
features.savings: Doing 50+ documents a day? That's 2.5 hours saved daily. Over a month — 50 hours.
features.more: And much more — signatures, amount-in-words, encrypted backup, and more.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1.question: Is my data really never sent anywhere?
faq.q1.answer: Correct. MaktabatyPro makes zero network requests. Everything — templates, filled documents, your PDF library — is processed and stored locally on your device in IndexedDB. You can disconnect from the internet entirely and every feature keeps working.
faq.q2.question: What happens after my 3-day trial ends?
faq.q2.answer: Your account and any templates you created stay on your device — they're just locked until you activate a paid license. Activating Standard or Multi unlocks everything instantly, with no reinstall needed.
faq.q3.question: Can I move my license to a new computer?
faq.q3.answer: Yes. Standard is licensed to one machine at a time — deactivate on the old device and activate on the new one from the same account. The Multi plan includes 2 machines, and you can add more anytime for +249 MAD each.
faq.q4.question: Can I upgrade from Standard to Multi later?
faq.q4.answer: Yes, at any time — contact us and pay only the difference between the two licenses. Your templates, library, and settings carry over automatically.
faq.q6.question: Which languages does the interface support?
faq.q6.answer: Arabic, French, Spanish and English, fully translated including right-to-left layout for Arabic. Switch languages anytime from the footer, even offline. and we will add more.
privacy.feature1.title: Zero network requests
privacy.feature1.text: Everything runs locally in your browser. No servers, no APIs, no telemetry. Disconnect from the internet entirely — it still works.
privacy.feature2.title: Local storage only
privacy.feature2.text: All data stored in IndexedDB on your machine. No cloud sync, no third-party storage. You control the backup — encrypted export files.
privacy.feature3.title: No account required
privacy.feature3.text: No sign-up, no email, no phone number. Download, open, use. Your administrative documents contain national IDs and private data — they should never need an account on someone else's server.
privacy.feature4.title: PDF encryption built-in
privacy.feature4.text: Password-protect exported PDFs with user and owner passwords. Control print, copy, and modification permissions.

pdfTools.heading: 30 PDF Tools. All Offline.
pdfTools.subheading: No uploads. No queues. No file size limits. Everything processes on your machine, instantly.
moreTools.heading: Everything you need to manage your documents in one place
moreTools.card1.title: Archive & PDF Library
moreTools.card1.text: Store, organize, and tag all your documents and PDFs in one safe place on your device. Quick search by name or keyword, one-click re-printing, and full tracking of your work archive — without jumping between Windows folders.
moreTools.card4.title: Advanced Text Editor
moreTools.card4.text: Edit letters, correspondence, and administrative documents freely inside the app. Direct export to PDF and Word (DOCX) while keeping a clean format that's ready to print immediately.
moreTools.card5.title: Full PDF Toolbox
moreTools.card5.text: More than 30 tools to process PDFs fully offline: merge, split, compress to meet government portal upload limits, convert images, and protect files — fast, with never uploading your documents online.
localArchive.heading: Every past document, one search away
localArchive.subheading: Your finished documents live in a searchable local archive on your device — find, retrieve, and re-print any client document instantly, without digging through Windows folders.
localArchive.feature1.title: Search in seconds
localArchive.feature1.text: Find any past document by client name, number, or keyword — without scrolling through folders.
localArchive.feature2.title: Retrieve & re-print anytime
localArchive.feature2.text: Reopen and re-print a client's certificate or request with one click — no need to rebuild it.
localArchive.feature3.title: Tag & organize
localArchive.feature3.text: Tag documents by client or type, add notes, and keep your archive ready to print at any moment.
platform.heading: Works everywhere
platform.text: Install as PWA in your browser, or use the desktop app on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Same features, same offline experience, any device.
